name: V-Key V-OS Threat Intelligence
description: Collects mobile application runtime security events, device inventory, and app integrity telemetry from V-Key V-OS BSI into Cortex XSIAM.
author: Prima Secondary Ramadhan
useCases: Ingest V-Key V-OS runtime mobile security violations (Jailbreak/Root, Hooking, Debuggers, Tampering) into Cortex XSIAM.
Collect mobile device hardware profiles and application package telemetry for asset context.
Automate threat correlation and response for protected mobile banking and enterprise applications.
